Transition (label = lane state that causes it)
How this FSM fits with the entry and exit lane FSMs
one instance runs for every booking, executed by the policy firmware on the RISC-V core.
only ENTRY_VALIDATE, ENTRY_RECORD, EXIT_VALIDATE, EXIT_RECORD and EXIT_FINALIZE move a booking; every other lane state stays inside one booking state.
the 15 / 45-minute countdown runs only in HELD. A verified arrival stops it, so a later gate fault or missing backup never causes a no-show fee.
HELD_NOT_ARRIVED counts HELD. IN_TRANSIT counts ENTERED_NOT_PARKED plus parked cars that left their bay. INSIDE_COUNT changes only at ENTRY_RECORD and EXIT_RECORD.
a booking owns exactly one bay from commit to CLOSED. ENTRY_REASSIGN swaps it atomically, so no bay ever has two owners and no booking is left with none.
